dz: 多米尼加共和国从海地获得独立.
de: The Dominican Republic gains independence from Haiti.

dz: 在波托马克河下游的快活巡航中,一把枪在蒸汽战列舰"普林斯顿号"(USS Princeton)上爆炸,杀死了六人,其中包括国务卿阿贝尔·乌普舒尔. John Tyler总统也是机上人员,没有被炸伤.
de: A gun explodes on board the steam warship USS Princeton during a pleasure cruise down the Potomac River, killing six, including Secretary of State Abel Upshur. President John Tyler, who is also on board, is not injured from the blast.

dz: 奥斯卡一世国王登上瑞典和挪威的王位.

dz: 冰岛议会在关闭了45年后重新开放.
de: The Althing, the parliament of Iceland, is reopened after 45 years of closure.

de: The Baháʼí calendar begins. This is the first day of the first year of the Baháʼí calendar. It is annually celebrated by members of the Baháʼí Faith as the Baháʼí New Year or Náw-Rúz.

de: One of the most important battles of the Dominican War of Independence from Haiti takes place near the city of Santiago de los Caballeros.

de: Báb: A merchant of Shiraz announces that he is a Prophet and founds a religious movement. He is considered to be a forerunner of the Baháʼí Faith.

te: Samuel Morse sends the message "What hath God wrought" (a biblical quotation, Numbers 23:23) from a committee room in t…
dz: 塞缪尔·莫尔斯(Samuel Morse)从美国首都的一个委员会房间向马里兰州巴尔的摩市的助手阿尔弗雷德·魏尔(Alfred Vail)发出"上帝做了什么"(圣经引文,第23:23号)的信息,以开启巴尔的摩和华盛顿特区之间的商业电报线路.
de: Samuel Morse sends the message "What hath God wrought" (a biblical quotation, Numbers 23:23) from a committee room in the United States Capitol to his assistant, Alfred Vail, in Baltimore, Maryland, to inaugurate a commercial telegraph line between Baltimore and Washington D.C.

de: Joseph Smith, founder of the Latter Day Saint movement, and his brother Hyrum Smith, are killed by a mob at the Carthage, Illinois jail.

de: The Quorum of the Twelve Apostles, headed by Brigham Young, is reaffirmed as the leading body of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (LDS Church).

t: 菲律宾总督纳西索·克拉夫里亚(Narciso Claveria)通过跳过12月31日星期二来签…
te: Governor-general of the Philippines Narciso Claveria signs a decree to reform the country's calendar by skipping Tuesda…
dz: 菲律宾总督纳西索·克拉夫里亚(Narciso Claveria)通过跳过12月31日星期二来签署一项改革国家日历的法令,作为解决自斐迪南·麦哲伦于1521年到来以来所存在的异常现象.
de: Governor-general of the Philippines Narciso Claveria signs a decree to reform the country's calendar by skipping Tuesday, December 31, as a solution to anomalies that had existed since Ferdinand Magellan's arrival in 1521.

de: The treaty of Tangier ends the Franco-Moroccan War, which Morocco lost, and forces it to recognise the French possessions in Algeria.

de: The Millerites (followers of Baptist preacher William Miller) anticipate the end of the world in conjunction with the Second Advent of Christ. The following day becomes known as the Great Disappointment.

t: 1821 年 9 月 27 日墨西哥脱离西班牙独立后，菲律宾跳过了这一日期，以便与亚洲其他国家…
te: The Philippines skipped this date in order to align the country with the rest of Asia, as the trading interest switched…
dz: 1821 年 9 月 27 日墨西哥脱离西班牙独立后，菲律宾跳过了这一日期，以便与亚洲其他国家保持一致，因为贸易兴趣转向中国、荷属东印度群岛和邻近领土。在群岛上，1844 年 12 月 30 日星期一紧随其后的是 1845 年 1 月 1 日星期三。
de: The Philippines skipped this date in order to align the country with the rest of Asia, as the trading interest switched to China, Dutch East Indies and neighboring territories after Mexico gained independence from Spain on 27 September 1821. In the islands, Monday, 30 December 1844 was immediately followed by Wednesday, 1 January 1845.
